page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines. Upper part: a large display title in faint capitals, then smaller centred lines. Lower middle: a block of smaller lines, set in a narrower measure. Handwritten shelfmark at the top left, not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is very faint: the printed ink is pale blue-grey and the page is mostly lost to the paper texture, so the lines above are only approximate in position and length. The large display title at the top and the small lines below cannot be read letter by letter. Lines near the foot of the page may also be printed but are too faint to count. The brown handwritten marking "Gal. 8.378." at top left is a library shelfmark and was left out. No engraving or stamp is visible.
